The Perch

The piece that starts every collection.

More PHAÖRA collectors entered through The Perch than any other work. At $16,500 it is the lowest barrier in the collection — and the highest density of craft per dollar. Forty years of accumulated skill in a piece that fits on a shelf.

I
Single-vein quartzBoth birds carved from one unbroken vein of white quartz — the natural continuity of the stone is visible in the finished piece.
II
18k gold-plated talonsThe talon mounts are cast in bronze and plated with 18k gold. A detail visible only on close inspection — the mark of a craftsman working for the piece, not the price.
III
Rose quartz crown inlayThe pink blush at each bird's crown is inlaid rose quartz, not paint. It will not fade, chip, or age.
IV
Deep violet amethyst baseThe cluster base is selected individually — not all amethyst is equal. This one was chosen for saturation, crystal uniformity, and the way it absorbs light.

Origin

Minas Gerais, Brazil

The white quartz used in The Perch was mined from a single vein in Minas Gerais — a region that has been producing extraordinary crystal formations for over a century of collection. The amethyst cluster base is a natural geological event: iron-trace quartz grown in a volcanic cavity over approximately 80 million years.
